issues.description: Identifier 'score_counter' (a data variable) is named in the problem statement, but the template repository does not declare any variable with that name, and the solution repository declares a different identifier 'score_cnt'. Problem statement: asks students to store the result in a variable named 'score_counter'. Template (no declaration): .data section only contains 'hello' (no score variable). Solution: declares 'score_cnt dd 0' at the .data section. This naming mismatch and missing declaration in the template can cause student confusion and automated grading failures because submissions and graders may expect the exact variable name 'score_counter'.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Preferred options: (A) Update solution_repository/helloWorld.asm to declare and use 'score_counter dd 0' (replace 'score_cnt') and add the same declaration to template_repository/helloWorld.asm in the .data section so students have the storage available; OR (B) Change the problem statement to require 'score_cnt' instead of 'score_counter' if that name is intentionally preferred. Ensure the chosen name is present in the template .data section and used in the solution so automated checks and student submissions align.

issues.description: Identifier naming mismatch for the variable that is meant to store the result/score: the problem statement explicitly requires a variable named `score_counter` (problem_statement.md), the solution implementation declares a variable named `score_cnt` in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm, and the template repository does not declare any corresponding variable (no `score_counter` or `score_cnt`). A student reading the problem will look for `score_counter` in the provided template; finding no declaration and then seeing `score_cnt` in the solution creates confusion about which identifier is intended and where to place the variable in the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: rename `score_cnt` in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm to `score_counter` and add a matching `score_counter` declaration in template_repository/helloWorld.asm (e.g., insert `score_counter dd 0` into the .data section). Alternatively, if `score_cnt` is preferred, update problem_statement.md to require `score_cnt` instead. Ensure the same exact identifier appears in the problem statement, template, and solution so students can unambiguously map the requirement to the code.
